ingles.titulo: What’s Behind the Taos Hum Nobody Can Explain?
ingles.descripcion: Did you know only 2% of people can hear the mysterious Taos hum? This low‑frequency sound (32‑80 Hz) first appeared in the 1990s and has been reported worldwide—from Windsor to Auckland and Whitehorse. Scientists link it to industrial plants, tinnitus, or unknown sources. Watch to decide if it’s a scientific puzzle or an unsolved mystery.
